Name: melee-strike-zombie
Comment: Decisive hypothesis test: native StartCommand_Melee2(target) + super.EvaluateHit against a ZOMBIE (not a bot). meleefight spawns a machete Survivor bot + 1 brain-driven zombie (ZmbM_PatrolNormal_Autumn, init_ai=true) registered hostile. PASS marker (in RPT, DM_BOT_DEBUG_FIGHT): 'start melee2 target=' then 'ApplyZombieExtraDamage ammo=... target=' (ApplyZombieExtraDamage fires ONLY from our EvaluateHit override, which vanilla HandleHitEvent calls ONLY when native WasHit() emitted => proves native hit-detection works for zombies). Zombie death = additional confirmation. Bot healthRaw via botdump confirms the bot survived zombie counterattacks.
